info.title: SiteCheck API
info.description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents: image generation, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, embeddings, LLM chat, website audits and contact enrichment, web page to Markdown reader, PDF to text, sitemap URLs, tech stack detection, translation, exchange rates, e-mail pre-check, domain RDAP/DNS lookup, Solana token checks, trending tokens and wallet holdings, plus business and compliance data (EU VAT/VIES, IBAN, LEI/GLEIF, US recalls, OSHA/EPA violations, UK insolvency notices). Also: SEO metadata, link checking, redirect chains, security headers, mail DNS (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), QR codes, language detection, photo EXIF, identifier validation, image OCR, SEC filings, SEC financials, Congress bills, macro rates, UK company data, GitHub repo stats, Hacker News, Wikipedia, gas prices, Solana swap quotes, ERC-20 token checks, ENS names, EVM wallet balances, EVM balances, transactions and contract calls, Solana transactions and accounts, crypto prices, candles and order books, DeFi TVL, yields and stablecoins, SEC insider trades, weather, geocoding and holidays, IP owners and postcodes, npm, PyPI and crates package data and vulnerabilities, GitHub profiles, arXiv papers and DOIs, structured extraction, summaries, sentiment and reranking, HTML tables and RSS feeds. Plus prediction-market search, briefs, quotes and unsigned buy transactions, powered by Panta. Payment: x402, USDC on Base, Solana or Arc. No signup, no API key.
info.x-guidance: Call any /api/* operation without payment first. The 402 answer's PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON, x402 v2) lists one "exact" USDC option per network (Base, Solana, Arc). Sign one with an x402 client and repeat the request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Payment settles only when the call succeeds.
